items.excerpt: Tamber 2.0 restructures the assistive (non-generative) platform into five connected creative apps and adds native Windows support, gesture control and natural-language DAW commands. It is pitched as a system that helps you drive your existing tools and find sounds, not a prompt box that spits out finished songs.

Apple Music told industry partners on Aug 20 that it will show visible 'Made With AI' labels later this year for tracks whose songs, lyrics, artwork or music videos were materially generated with AI. Unlike Spotify and Deezer, Apple runs no detection of its own — labels and distributors have to self-declare via the AI Transparency Tags it quietly introduced in March.

The new AI chart-eligibility standards police the recording — the vocal, the master — because that is what detection tools can actually measure, while leaving the songwriting stage entirely unexamined. The piece argues the industry has quietly defined 'human' as 'human-performed', not 'human-written'.

AI-made music is now over half of new uploads on Deezer but only 1–3% of actual listening. Analyst Bas Grasmayer argues the human music business loses not to AI's speed but to its own broken workflows, and should compete on connection and release craft instead of volume.

SSG Audio's Loudness Pro is a one-knob mastering limiter whose AI engine recalculates the clip/limit split thousands of times per second instead of holding a fixed threshold, aiming to hit a loudness target without pumping or flattened transients. It adds automatic dither for 16-bit exports and runs at roughly 5ms latency.

After losing the GEMA case in Munich, Suno CEO Mikey Shulman laid out 'a clear set of principles' and confirmed the platform will add watermarking, fingerprinting and download limits to stop mass distribution of Suno tracks onto streaming services.

VAEMI's Synterra is a standalone 'bio-interactive' generative synth that reads changing data from plants, fungi, fruit, conductive surfaces, light and touch and turns it into evolving notes and rhythms via a probability engine. A MIDI Scale Mode lets an external keyboard or DAW constrain its generative output to your harmony.

AI-assisted coding has made building your own plugin cheap enough that solo producers and established audio companies alike are shipping bespoke tools. Developers interviewed say the bottleneck has moved from writing DSP code to knowing what to ask for — human direction and taste still decide whether the result is usable.
